summary.text: Phil McGrane is Idaho's Republican Secretary of State, seeking a second term. He previously served as Ada County Clerk (2019-2023) and worked as an elections specialist in the Ada County Clerk's office.

paragraphs.text: Earned a bachelor's degree in philosophy from the University of Washington (2005), a law degree from the University of Denver (2010) and a master's in public administration from Boise State University (2014).
Served as Ada County Clerk from 2019 to 2023 and as Idaho Secretary of State since 2023.
